objective: Compute positive-cohort birth-age mass and shape diagnostics, compose frozen reference errors across time and labels, and measure two native time-by-birth grid interactions.
source_scope: Add-only diagnostic crate; all 105 BR03 crate files, original physical owners, one-way BASS donor, source identities, CX half flow and S10 four-corner controller are immutable.

physical_contract.s: db/dt; signed s/H is distinct from sqrt(3)*abs(s/H)
physical_contract.age_coordinate: A=t_observation-t_birth; x=A/T or local A/dt is explicitly identified
physical_contract.kappa: total absorption rate per second, sum of HI/HeI/HeII/DI rates
physical_contract.born: reference-comoving photon number in a declared interval
physical_contract.shape_normalization: Normalize exact and numerical positive measures by their own mass; report the mass defect separately.
physical_contract.zero_source: Empty physical measure; conditional age shape is undefined.
physical_contract.underflow: A positive mathematical mass rounded to zero is separate from zero source; log-domain shape diagnostics may remain defined.
physical_contract.native_geometry: Unmodified one-way background, no Einstein feedback from H/He/D.

observable_contract.mass_defect: Photon number quadrature error in the stated frozen reference.
observable_contract.cdf_sup: Normalized CDF supremum distance, dimensionless; thresholds require a separately justified variation bound.
observable_contract.w1: Normalized 1D Wasserstein-1 in the declared age coordinate; multiply by T or dt for seconds.
observable_contract.moments: Signed first and raw second age moment defects; they do not determine the complete age distribution.
observable_contract.mixture_bounds: Label-weighted component distance plus normalization-weight total variation; not exact unlabelled mixture distance.
observable_contract.native_differences: Measured grid differences, not absolute error versus an exact evolving solution.
observable_contract.native_ledgers: Independent photon number, competitive species event sum and total energy residuals, with explicit normalizing scale.

applicability_limits: Frozen analytic distribution certificate does not directly bound evolving gas and opacity response.
Native exports contain moments and q2, not the full retained age-energy-angle joint distribution.
No universal temporal order, full EoR initial condition or full angular/spectral/age convergence claim.
Binary64 numerical diagnostics are independently checked; they are not directed-rounding interval enclosures.
CMB gauge, hierarchy, line-of-sight and CAMB/CLASS-specific protocol sections do not apply to this bounded H/He/D source-integration unit.
